disposition: rider over the center divide; air ambulance stood by, then canceled
summary: A motorcycle went down on northbound Interstate 5 north of Lebec, with the rider hunched over the center divide and other vehicles behind. A second crash north of Tejon was reported as non-injury, and the air ambulance that had been placed on standby was canceled.

disposition: both left in a white Dodge Charger westbound on 7th Standard Road
summary: A caller reported two people had entered a yard, seen on a camera toward the back of the property, and had been there when the call came in almost 30 minutes earlier. Both left in a white Dodge Charger westbound on 7th Standard Road.
A crew was sent for a fall detected by a smart watch near Merle Haggard Drive and Spectrum Parkway.
Officers were sent after a caller reported two people in masks had been walking around a residence for about two hours. The caller said they were not trying to get in.
Officers were sent to check on a woman and a 5-year-old at the Walmart neighborhood market in the 5600 block of Calloway Drive.
Officers checked on an 8-year-old boy reported walking westbound near Mount Vernon Avenue and Bernard Street.
Crews were sent for a cardiac arrest in the 2600 block of Fremont Street.

disposition: a woman was reported to be in a mental health crisis
summary: Officers were sent to a welfare check after a caller reported the sounds of an argument, screaming and banging. A woman at the home was reported to be in a mental health crisis.

disposition: heavy smoke from a building; reinforced, then scaled back to one engine
summary: Crews were sent to a structure fire in the 2000 block of Lake Street and found heavy smoke coming from a building of about 1,500 square feet. The fire was reinforced and worked as a high-priority search, then scaled back to one engine with smoke still in the attic.
Officers were sent to a priority domestic call at a service station at Fairfax Road and Auburn Street. A man was reported to be walking east on Auburn.
Officers were sent to check on a man reported to be on the grass near a business sign in the 2100 block of Columbus Street.
A crew was sent for a patient having seizures in the parking lot of a restaurant in the 3500 block of Rosedale Highway.

disposition: suspects ran northeast across the railroad tracks
summary: A market in Shafter reported another theft of cash, and the suspects ran northeast across the railroad tracks.
A crew was sent for chest pain at a residence in the 7000 block of Auburn Street.
One company handled a transient warming fire in the middle of a plowed field, and the rest of the assignment was canceled.
Officers were sent after a caller reported a man who claimed to have a firearm in his pocket and had arrived in a gray SUV.
A woman told officers her boyfriend had taken her keys and her wallet and left on foot westbound.
A caller reported a woman in a red dress and sweater who came to the door saying she was lost and needed help, and said a car horn had been sounding nearby for about 30 minutes.

disposition: units asked to check on them
summary: Units were asked to check on juveniles who had run away from a group home on Pecan Grove, and to stand by for them near White Lane.
A caller told officers he had found his stolen trailer parked in the backyard of a residence in the 1100 block of El Rancho Drive.

disposition: woman said a man took her keys
summary: An open 911 line carried a loud argument, and a woman told officers a man had taken her keys and left in a black and gray Subaru.

disposition: perimeter set; offense confirmed; officers searched for shell casings
summary: A caller reported hearing a gunshot and seeing three people fighting across the street, one of them in a red shirt and possibly armed. Officers set a perimeter around South Union Avenue and Serrano Drive, confirmed an offense and searched the alley behind the fire station for shell casings.

disposition: he fled and left the ladder behind
summary: A resident reported a man in a neon green reflective vest using a ladder toward the rear alley of a property in the 300 block of Francis Street. He fled and left the ladder behind.

disposition: caller said she would be held for an evaluation
summary: Deputies were sent to help a property owner remove a woman from a property. The caller said she was on a shed and would be held for a mental health evaluation.
A crew was sent for an unknown medical aid at a home in the 900 block of Chester Place, where a translator was needed.
Officers asked a local hospital to check whether any victims of an assault with a deadly weapon had come in.
Crews were sent to a carbon dioxide alarm in the 18300 block of Basel Drive.
A single vehicle went off the roadway on northbound Highway 99 near an overcrossing. The call was run as a highway incident while crews worked out the number of people hurt.
Officers were sent to a battery report in the 7100 block of Radcliffe Avenue, where one person declined medical aid.
A pickup was reported in the center divide on northbound Highway 99 just north of Olive Drive, and a unit asked for another unit to make a break so the truck could be pushed to the right shoulder.
Crews were sent to a motion alarm at the southwest door of a service station in the 3200 block of Taft Highway.

disposition: blue SUV left; no firearm recovered
summary: Deputies were sent to a report of people with a small black handgun in the 8200 block of Kimber Avenue. A blue newer-model Subaru SUV left, and no firearm was recovered.

disposition: medical aid staged; channel cleared for emergency traffic
summary: Officers were sent to a domestic disturbance on Whitley Court reported as a battery between a mother and a daughter, with medical aid staged in the area. The channel was cleared for emergency traffic while officers worked the call.
Officers were sent to a business in the 2600 block of Mount Vernon Avenue where a man was refusing to leave.
Officers were sent to the 300 block of Pico Street after a caller reported people in the backyard, with no one seen at the time.
Officers were sent to a report of an assault with a baseball bat on Chester Lane, where a 40-year-old man was reported as a possible victim.
Officers were sent to check on a little girl heard screaming in the parking lot of a movie theater in the 1000 block of California Avenue, just south of the railroad tracks.
Deputies were sent to a domestic disturbance south of Rosedale Highway in Fairhaven, where a woman was heard yelling at another person and the caller said a man had battered her friend.
A caller asked for a translator and hung up, and there was no answer on the call back to a home in the 1800 block of Monterey Street.

disposition: same address drew three calls; the man left in a gray Infiniti coupe
summary: Officers were sent to a home in the 2000 block of Carlton Street where a man was reported to be fighting family members. The same address drew a second call just before 4 a.m. and a third before dawn, and the man was reported to have got into a gray Infiniti coupe.
A crew was sent for chest pain at an assisted living building in the 3200 block of Brookside Drive.
A crew was sent for difficulty breathing at the front office of a facility on Riverside Street.
A commercial fire alarm brought a crew to a building in the 4000 block of Scenic River Lane.

disposition: footage showed a man hitting the door
summary: A glass-break alarm brought a unit to a gas station, where footage showed a man in a black hooded sweatshirt and a shopping cart hitting the door with a stick.
A crew was sent for a patient who was hemorrhaging on Shawnee Drive.
An on-site alarm brought a unit to a home in the 2700 block of Payne Drive.
A caller reported a man trying to force a woman into the back seat of a car in the alley behind a residence. There was no vehicle description, and officers were sent back to the block.
CHP was sent to the southbound Highway 99 on-ramp at Olive Drive for a woman reported to be lying in the roadway.
Crash alert on State Route 58 near I-5.
Person with traumatic injury at Cambridge Village Apts.
